provenance.binding_limit: Historical launch selects the same executable path; the old export lacks an embedded input hash. Current file hash matches retained repo identity, but this alone does not cryptographically bind every old export byte to that executable.

limitations: Retained Ghidra pseudocode is non-source and not a fresh REA observation.
Export Address headers differ from hexadecimal comments by 0x400000; retain both and do not substitute one as a live procedure selector without image-base reconciliation.
Decompiled signatures, extraout variables and signed char displays may be artifacts; findings use explicit byte operations and call order.
Static host behavior does not prove ECU acceptance or firmware effects.
